build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a build_task function that creates a PHYRE task scene
create_dynamic_bars_with_C_add: create dynamic bar bodies using C.add with scale, angle, bottom, and left positioning parameters
position_body_with_set: position a body in the scene by calling set with bottom and left coordinates
create_dynamic_ball_with_C_add: create a dynamic ball body using C.add with a specified scale parameter
update_task_with_spatial_relationship: update the task goal by calling C.update_task with body1, body2, and a SpatialRelationship
